newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's luxury home price hits high -- property agent.
newsitem.headline: HK's luxury home price hits high -- property agent.

text.p: Hong Kong's booming luxury property market scaled another peak when a 2,973-square-foot apartment fetched HK$50 million (US$6.47 million) in a recent sale, property agent First Pacific Davies said on Monday.
The duplex apartment in the upmarket Repulse Bay area of Hong Kong island was bought for HK$16,818 per square foot by a local businessman for his own use, it said in a statement.

"The price represents a 17 percent increase on the HK$14,373 per square foot achieved by the previous record for a duplex apartment, which was sold earlier this month," Jimmy Fong, general manager of residential sales, said in the statement.
Fong said the increase demonstrated that strong demand for luxury property would continue for high-calibre units.
